attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arkansas state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per AR tax code (2025). Top rate reduced from 4.4% to 3.9% effective 1/1/2025.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Arkansas Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Arkansas tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ar_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /ar_taxable_income xdef
0 /ar_tax xdef
ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_1_limit min result.ar_bracket_1_rate mul ar_tax add /ar_tax xdef
ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_1_limit gt { ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_2_limit min result.ar_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.ar_bracket_2_rate mul ar_tax add /ar_tax xdef } if
ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_2_limit gt { ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_3_limit min result.ar_bracket_2_limit sub 0 max result.ar_bracket_3_rate mul ar_tax add /ar_tax xdef } if
ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_3_limit gt { ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_4_limit min result.ar_bracket_3_limit sub 0 max result.ar_bracket_4_rate mul ar_tax add /ar_tax xdef } if
ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_4_limit gt { ar_taxable_income result.ar_bracket_4_limit sub result.ar_bracket_5_rate mul ar_tax add /ar_tax xdef } if
ar_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Arkansas tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arkansas military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per AR Code § 26-51-426 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Arkansas military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Arkansas Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.ar_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.ar_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.ar_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.ar_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.ar_military_retirement_exclusion result.ar_sbp_exclusion add /result.ar_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.ar_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.ar_adjusted_agi xdef
"Arkansas military retirement exclusion: $" result.ar_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ar_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Arkansas SBP exclusion: $" result.ar_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Arkansas total military exclusion: $" result.ar_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
